lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct, high-contrast vertical line segments; spacing is relatively dense in the mid-torso region and increases significantly toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The two posterior-most segments (lines 9 and 10) are abbreviated, with line 10 manifesting as a dashed vertical segment terminating high on the upper haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density; three discrete high-contrast white spots are visible on the lateral posterior flank and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper haunch exhibit a horizontal geometric alignment relative to the dorsal-ventral axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white facial spots located on the lower mandible/cheek; white transverse bands visible on the lower extremities (carpus and tarsus).
